## Change

What task does this address, and what behavior now works?

## Validation

Commands actually run and their results. State anything untested.

## Compatibility

Pinned upstream source/symbols, fixture IDs, and any intentional differences.
For reference changes, explain provenance and why the expectations changed.

## Handoff

Update TASKS.md and docs/HANDOFF.md. Record material decisions in docs/DECISIONS.md.
